maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is mainly leasing Gamma Knife and radiation therapy equipment to hospitals for new programs, not repair or aftermarket servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Hospitals pay lease fees per procedure; payers are mainly commercial insurers and Medicare mix, not clearly mostly government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by placing leased radiosurgery equipment with hospitals and some equity investments in centers, not a steady stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Multi-year leases of Gamma Knife and proton/linac equipment embedded in hospital cancer programs make switching costly and disruptive.

notes: Government share of final payment (Medicare) is uncertain; answered no on that basis.
